sections.heading: What comes next in FITA?

faq.a: Select the categories you want in Apple Health, Health Connect or Health Sync permissions.

faq.a: После синхронизации открой свежую запись в Apple Health или Health Connect: источник покажет, каким приложением она добавлена.

faq.q: Как выбрать данные для Фиты?
faq.a: В разрешениях Apple Health или Health Connect включи чтение нужных категорий для Фиты.

faq.q: Можно обсудить данные в другом ИИ?
faq.a: В профиле Фиты включи «Доступ для AI-ассистентов», выбери категории и подключи MCP.

en.description: Bring Strava workouts to FITA through Apple Health or Health Connect. Explore your training alongside sleep and heart rate in one AI chat.

sections.heading: Which data syncs?
paragraphs: ✓ shared, ◐ shared under the stated conditions, ✕ not shared, — no information in the sources.

sections.heading: Enable the correct direction
steps: iPhone: You → settings → Manage Apps and Devices → Health → + → Connect; allow Workouts & Routes and enable Send to Health.
Android: You → settings → Manage Apps and Devices → Health Connect; follow the prompts.
Inspect a new repository session, then allow FITA to read workouts.

sections.heading: How do you check sharing and avoid duplicates?
paragraphs: Find a recent record in Apple Health or Health Connect and check its source. Choose one writing route per category. In Apple Health, set source priority in Data Sources & Access.

sections.heading: What comes next in FITA?
paragraphs: Allow FITA to read your chosen categories. Bring sleep, heart rate and workouts together, follow your personal trends and talk with your Russian-language AI companion. MCP also shares your chosen snapshot with an external assistant.

faq.q: How do I check the Strava connection?
faq.a: After syncing, open a recent Apple Health or Health Connect record and check the source app.

faq.q: How do I choose data for FITA?
faq.a: Allow FITA to read your chosen categories in Apple Health or Health Connect permissions.

faq.q: Can I use another AI assistant?
faq.a: Enable AI assistant access in your FITA profile, choose categories and connect MCP.
